milind-soni-openmausbot.tagline: Cada bot con su propia computadora.

identidad.text: Every bot in the sidebar is a real agent — Claude or Codex running locally under the hood — with its own personality, its own model, its own cloud computer, and its own connected apps.

computadora.text: Every bot can get its own Linux computer in the cloud, with a desktop you can watch live while it works and take over at any time.

memoria.text: memory of its thread, model, computer, and apps

rutinas.text: Schedules (routines) can run once, on selected weekdays, or every 5–1,440 minutes, using either a bot's configured model/computer or the Cloud VM runner.

apps.text: A one-click marketplace over Composio Sessions: Gmail, Slack, GitHub, Notion, Linear and hundreds more.

coordinacion.text: OpenMausBot is the open-source version of that shape: a team of agents in a chat app, each with its own model, its own computer and its own connected apps.

aprobaciones.text: A permission broker turns every risky action into a decision you make, for cloud and local computers alike.

desatendido.text: To keep working independently of your laptop, you need an always-on host, such as a separately configured server or the optional paid MausBot Cloud workspace.

milind-soni-openmausbot.note: README: cada bot tiene personalidad, modelo, computadora y apps; memoria y rutinas por bot; equipos y group chats; aprobaciones. Corre en tu máquina, así que no es 24/7 salvo que lo pongas en un VPS.

leepokai-codync.tagline: Tus agentes CLI, convertidos en bots.

identidad.text: Persistent named bots, group chats, quote replies, bots asking each other for help, approval cards, per-bot memory, remote screen, voice calls and 'needs you / done' notifications.

computadora.text: Remote screen. See and control your computer from the iPhone over WebRTC, and let bots use the screen themselves through the built-in computer tool.

memoria.text: Persistent named bots, group chats, quote replies, bots asking each other for help, approval cards, per-bot memory, remote screen, voice calls.

apps.text: Remote screen. See and control your computer from the iPhone over WebRTC, and let bots use the screen themselves through the built-in computer tool.

coordinacion.text: Many bots, one team. Run as many bots as you like side by side, each with its own agent, project folder and approvals... Put several in a group chat and they answer in turn.

aprobaciones.text: The chat only shows what matters: your messages, each turn's final reply, approval cards and notices.

desatendido.text: Bots run on the Claude, ChatGPT or other plan your agents are already signed in with, on your own computer.

leepokai-codync.note: README: bots persistentes con nombre, memoria por bot, group chats, aprobaciones y herramienta de computadora. No encontré scheduler/rutinas en el README, así que rutinas queda en falso. Los agentes corren en tu computadora.

rutinas.text: Scheduled tasks: recurring jobs executed by the agent, with optional script gates that avoid waking it when there is no work.

coordinacion.text: Spawn teammates from chat... with shared rooms and canvases.

cosmicstack-labs-mercury-agent.tagline: Asistente y equipo de bots autoalojado.

identidad.text: Mercury is an open-source agent with a personality you write yourself, a memory that stays on your disk, and a permission system that sits between the model and your machine.

computadora.text: It reads and writes your files, runs commands, ships code through git and GitHub, researches the web and keeps a schedule.

memoria.text: Second Brain: typed, deduplicated facts in SQLite with full-text search, all on your disk.

rutinas.text: Scheduled automations - Mercury Bots run on schedules, hand work to each other, and deliver finished files.

coordinacion.text: Mercury Bots gives it a team. Persistent specialists research, write and ship on their own schedule.

aprobaciones.text: It asks before it acts. File access is scoped per folder, shell commands pass through a blocklist and an approval step.

desatendido.text: The runtime runs as a login service (LaunchAgent on macOS, systemd on Linux, Task Scheduler on Windows) and restarts itself after a crash.

cosmicstack-labs-mercury-agent.note: README: memoria en SQLite, scheduler, bots persistentes con especialistas, aprobaciones, daemon always-on. Opera archivos, shell, git y web; no es una GUI completa.

memoria.text: Agent-curated memory with periodic nudges. Autonomous skill creation after complex tasks. Skills self-improve during use.

rutinas.text: Built-in cron scheduler with delivery to any platform. Daily reports, nightly backups, weekly audits - all in natural language, running unattended.

agentes-chat.tagline: Slack con agentes que trabajan de verdad.
agentes-chat.summary: Alternativa open source a Slack donde personas y agentes comparten canales y DMs: cada agente tiene rol, presupuesto, computadora, navegador, memoria, rutinas, MCP y aprobaciones; web, escritorio y móvil.
strengths: Slack open source con agentes como miembros de canales y DMs, no un bot lateral
Computadora y navegador propios con takeover humano y aislamiento por workspace
Rutinas, memoria, MCP/Composio y aprobaciones en el mismo producto
Web, escritorio, iOS y Android
weaknesses: Producto muy joven: creado en noviembre de 2026 y en beta abierta
Self-hosting exige Docker/Postgres y operación
La calidad de los agentes depende del modelo y del runtime conectado
agentes-chat.comparison: Es la alternativa open source más directa a Grok Bot en formato Slack: equipo, computadora, rutinas, memoria y aprobaciones. Le falta madurez y recorrido.

identidad.text: Agents are members of the workspace, not a sidebar bot: they read the channel, answer when it's theirs to answer, and hand work back and forth.

computadora.text: Agents run commands and code on a computer that runs the runner: the server itself (the setup makes it the agents' computer by default), or a server, VM or laptop you connect.

memoria.text: Agents keep decisions, facts, preferences and lessons from conversations, learn from corrections and refused approvals, and propose changes to their own instructions for a person to accept.

rutinas.text: An agent works on a schedule ("every weekday at 9am") or on an event (a GitHub pull request, a Sentry issue, a new task, an incoming email) and delivers to a channel, a DM or the Drive.

apps.text: With a Composio key, Google Drive, Calendar, Sheets and Docs, Slack, Microsoft Teams, OneDrive, HubSpot, Salesforce, Zendesk, Asana, Figma, Intercom, Dropbox, Square, Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, YouTube, Pinterest, Reddit and WhatsApp Business connect through Composio.

coordinacion.text: Up to four agents answer, or none, and the message says who picked.

aprobaciones.text: Merge, deploy, rollback and anything a connector marks sensitive wait for the agent's owner or an admin, as a card in the chat.

desatendido.text: An agent works on a schedule ("every weekday at 9am") or on an event (a GitHub pull request, a Sentry issue, a new task, an incoming email) and delivers to a channel, a DM or the Drive.

agentes-chat.note: README y web oficial: Slack open source con agentes miembros del workspace, computadora y navegador propios, rutinas, memoria, MCP/Composio, aprobaciones y apps web/escritorio/móvil. Proyecto creado el 2026-11-09; se puntúa como beta abierta.
agentes-chat.release_highlight: 0.8.8: correcciones de escritorio y móvil; la base ya incluye canales, computadora y aprobaciones.
agentes-chat.release_impact: Nuevo en el ranking: 84.60 S. 8/8 pilares; producto joven y en beta abierta.

clawboo.tagline: Un jefe AI para tu equipo de agentes.
clawboo.summary: Estudio open source para desplegar equipos de agentes con un jefe que reparte tareas, memoria compartida, rutinas, conectores y aprobaciones; los agentes corren sobre Claude Code, Codex, Hermes, OpenClaw o el runtime propio.
strengths: Boo Zero reparte tareas y coordina varios runtimes
Memoria compartida y tablero durable
Rutinas, conectores MCP/Composio y aprobaciones
Corre local con una sola orden
weaknesses: Proyecto pequeño (171 estrellas) y ecosistema joven
La computadora es el entorno local, no una VM aislada por agente
Depende de runtimes externos y de sus propios límites de permisos
clawboo.comparison: Coordina agentes como un equipo real, pero su computadora es local y su ecosistema aún es pequeño frente a Grok Bot.

identidad.text: Ask once. Boo Zero, your team lead, splits the work into jobs on one board and hands each job to a teammate.

computadora.text: Share the Playwright or Chrome DevTools connector with an agent, and its Browser tab shows the latest screenshot from its browser. Each of those agents gets its own browser profile, so its logins stay its own.

memoria.text: Memory lives in Clawboo itself, so a fact one teammate saves can be recalled by any teammate, whatever tool it runs on.

rutinas.text: Put work on a clock. A team routine posts into the group chat for Boo Zero to pick up, and an agent routine hands one agent a task.

apps.text: A Connectors page starts or signs in to popular MCP servers for you (GitHub, Linear, Notion, Figma, Stripe, Playwright, a local folder and more; some ask for a key or token once). Gmail, Slack, Jira and 38 more apps connect through your Composio account: paste a Composio project key once, and Composio keeps those apps' sign-ins.

coordinacion.text: Boo Zero splits your request into jobs, hands them out, and pulls the results together in the chat.

aprobaciones.text: Risky tool calls that go through Clawboo ask you first, on any runtime.

desatendido.text: Every handoff is a real task on a durable board that survives restarts, and the team talks it through in one room.

clawboo.note: README: estudio de equipos de agentes con Boo Zero como jefe, varios runtimes, memoria compartida, rutinas, conectores y aprobaciones. La computadora es el entorno local; no hay VM aislada por agente.
clawboo.release_highlight: 0.7.0: Cua Driver para que los agentes usen apps de su propia pantalla en Linux.
clawboo.release_impact: Nuevo en el ranking: 79.50 A. Equipo y memoria fuertes; computadora local y ecosistema pequeño.

identidad.text: Each agent has its own name, memory, workspace and computer.

memoria.text: One permanent conversation, one memory and one workspace per agent, kept across restarts, upgrades and moves.

Schedule recurring work, see every agent's runs on one calendar, and layer in your own calendars.

rakazo.comparison: Cubre casi todas las piezas de Grok Bot con más adopción y multiplataforma; le falta madurez operativa y evidencias públicas de escala.

identidad.text: Persistent AI teammates with their own memory, routines, apps, and computer.

computadora.text: A browser, terminal, files, and a full desktop. Watch it work, take control to sign in, and hand it back.

memoria.text: Persistent AI teammates with their own memory, routines, apps, and computer.

rutinas.text: Run a bot on a schedule, from an email, or from a webhook, and see every run.

apps.text: Gmail, Slack, GitHub, Notion, Linear and thousands more, plus your own MCP servers and OpenAPI tools.

coordinacion.text: Put bots in a group and @mention them. They split the work, check each other, and report back.

aprobaciones.text: Decide which actions need your approval.

desatendido.text: Keeps working while your computer is off.
Run a bot on a schedule, from an email, or from a webhook, and see every run.

rakazo.note: README y web: bots persistentes con computadora/navegador, grupos, delegación, rutinas, memoria, integraciones y aprobaciones. Self-hosting con Docker; apps web, escritorio y móvil.
rakazo.release_highlight: 0.11.0: computadora local sin Docker en Mac, DMs de Teams y rutinas que vigilan una URL.
rakazo.release_impact: Nuevo en el ranking: 85.00 S. 8/8 pilares; la alternativa más completa a Grok Bot por producto.
